content.short: Layerswap is a cross chain transfer app for moving assets between wallets, blockchains, and supported exchanges.
content.description: Layerswap is a bridging and swapping service built to move assets across many blockchain networks and selected centralized exchanges with fewer steps than manual transfer routes. Its user guide highlights cross chain swaps, direct exchange to chain transfers, wallet based execution, and support for networks including TON. The product is positioned around affordability, speed, and simpler user experience, making it useful for people who need to bring funds onto TON or move assets out without stitching together multiple separate services.
content.meta: Layerswap helps users bridge and swap assets across many blockchains and exchanges, including transfer routes that connect with TON.
